label: spermatozoon
applicability_notes: Male germ cells without an inferred anatomical site; a sperm observation alone does not establish testis restriction.

label: coagulating gland
applicability_notes: Mouse anterior prostate/coagulating gland; no dog counterpart is assigned.

label: Mammary tissue (whole breast or mammary gland)
applicability_notes: Whole-organ observation includes stroma; it does not establish glandular-cell restriction. Source sex and lactation state remain separate metadata.

label: placenta
applicability_notes: Placenta-specific evidence qualifies directly; maternal/fetal compartment resolution is not required.

label: Cutaneous melanocytes
applicability_notes: Only cutaneous melanocytes; an unsited melanocyte label, eye, retina and inner ear do not qualify.

label: Hair follicle compartment
applicability_notes: Conditional acceptance of alopecia; includes follicular epithelial compartments. A bulk follicle does not resolve matrix versus bulge/stem-cell involvement or reversibility.

label: lymph node
applicability_notes: Distributed lymphatic and immune organ. Limited regional excision does not justify allowing expression across the entire lymph-node system.

label: spleen
applicability_notes: Conditional project allowance. Organ loss requires infection-risk management; expression in shared immune cells needs separate distribution review.

label: tonsil
applicability_notes: Native tonsil samples, with palatine tonsillectomy as the human rationale. Does not include adenoids, all mucosal lymphoid tissue or mouse NALT. Bulk source labels do not establish cell-type confinement.

label: appendix
applicability_notes: Human appendix label only; animal caecal lymphoid tissue is not mapped to vermiform appendix.
